CICIoT2023.provenance: None present in CSV schemas (Time_To_Live is IP TTL, not capture time)

ToN-IoT.provenance: Unix epoch seconds (e.g., 1554198358 = 2019-04-02T09:45:58Z in Network_dataset_1.csv; 1556203753 = 2019-04-25T14:49:13Z in GroundTruth_IoT_Fridge.csv). Absent in train_test_network.csv, Train_Test_Linux_process.csv, and Train_Test_Windows_10.csv.

Edge-IIoTset.provenance: Corrupted/inconsistent across files: '6.0'/'0.0' in ML-EdgeIIoT-dataset.csv and MITM_attack.csv; IP addresses ('192.168.0.128') in Modbus.csv; missing month/day ('2021 11:44:10.081753000') in DNN-EdgeIIoT-dataset.csv, Port_Scanning_attack.csv, and Temperature_and_Humidity.csv.

CICIoT2023.evidence: VERIFIED: 39/40-column CSV schemas contain aggregated flow/packet statistics and protocol flags only; no IP, MAC, gateway, or device ID column.

device_or_host_identifiers: separate per-device CSVs in Processed_IoT_dataset and Train_Test_IoT_dataset (e.g., Fridge, Garage_Door, GPS_Tracker, Modbus, Motion_Light, Thermostat, Weather)
ToN-IoT.evidence: VERIFIED: No explicit gateway_id column. Network CSVs contain src_ip/dst_ip (only 3 unique src_ip in first 5,000 rows of train_test_network.csv); IoT telemetry is split into per-sensor files with heterogeneous schemas.

device_or_host_identifiers: per-sensor subdirectories under Normal traffic/ (10 sensor types)
Edge-IIoTset.evidence: VERIFIED: No explicit gateway_id column. ML-EdgeIIoT-dataset.csv has only 7 unique ip.src_host and 7 unique ip.dst_host in the first 5,000 rows; Normal traffic is separated into 10 sensor folders while Attack traffic is separated by attack type.

limitations: Two 20 GB ToN-IoT archives (IoT Datasets/network_data.zip and IoT Datasets/Raw_datasets/network_data/normal_attack_pcaps.zip) are truncated with missing central directories and remain on HOLD.
SHA-256 checksums were calculated only for files <= 200 MiB; larger archives and multi-GB CSVs have sha256=null and must not be assumed checksum-verified.
Full 7z CRC testing (7z t) was run on archives <= 500 MiB; larger intact archives were verified via central-directory listing (7z l + zipfile) only.
Official upstream publisher manifests/checksums (CIC, UNSW, IEEE DataPort) have not yet been reconciled against local files.
No dataset contains verified genuine gateway identifiers; all gateway-level FL partitions must be explicitly reported as simulated logical partitions.

E1_IID_vs_Non_IID.rationale: Multi-class labelled tabular data verified across CICIoT2023 (MERGED_CSV), ToN-IoT (train_test_network.csv), and Edge-IIoTset (ML-EdgeIIoT-dataset.csv). Requires explicit simulated-client partition documentation, deduplication, and identifier stripping.

E2_Concept_Drift.rationale: CICIoT2023 lacks timestamps; ToN-IoT train_test_network.csv lacks ts; Edge-IIoTset frame.time is corrupted/incomplete. Only ToN-IoT Processed_Network_dataset / Processed_IoT_dataset + GroundTruth contain verifiable Unix/date timestamps, requiring Phase 1B chronological alignment verification.

E3_Benign_Drift_vs_Poisoning.rationale: Blocked by E2 temporal drift prerequisite and absence of native poisoning ground truth; requires validated temporal drift baseline plus versioned synthetic poisoning protocol.

E4_Adaptive_vs_Byzantine.rationale: Supported via FL simulation on verified labelled datasets once E1 client partitioning, deduplication, identifier stripping, and seeded Byzantine threat model are locked.

E5_Cross_Dataset_Generalization.rationale: Schemas are semantically heterogeneous (CICIoT2023 39/40 flow stats vs ToN-IoT 44/46 Bro/Zeek conn logs vs Edge-IIoTset 63 packet-header fields). Requires documented semantic feature and label ontology before any cross-dataset transfer.

E6_Ablation_and_Overhead.rationale: Supported on verified manageable baselines (train_test_network.csv 211,043 rows, ML-EdgeIIoT-dataset.csv 157,800 rows, CICIoT2023 MERGED_CSV) with deterministic seeds and compute/communication telemetry.
